ei.title: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은? [3점] Beca

fullPassage: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은? [3점] Because people tend to adapt, interrupting positive things with negative ones can actually increase enjoyment. Take commercials. Most people hate them, so ①removing them should make shows or other entertainment more enjoyable. But the opposite is true. Shows are actually ②more enjoyable when they’re broken up by annoying commercials. Because these less enjoyable moments break up adaptation to the ③positive experience of the show. Think about eating chocolate chips. The first chip is delicious: sweet, melt­in­your­mouth goodness. The second chip is also pretty good. But by the fourth, fifth, or tenth chip in a row, the goodness is no longer as pleasurable. We adapt. Interspersing positive experiences with less positive ones, however, can ④accelerate adaptation. Eating a Brussels sprout between chocolate chips or viewing commercials between parts of TV shows disrupts the process. The less positive moment makes the ⑤following positive one new again and thus more enjoyable. 5 영역 5

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ pleasant(기분 좋은) → annoying(짜증나는): 광고는 짜증나는 것이므로 pleasant는 부적절
det.analysis:
① positive: 긍정적인 것을 부정적인 것으로 끊는다 ← 적절
② increase: 즐거움을 증가시킨다 ← 적절
③ enjoyable: 더 즐겁게 만든다 ← 적절
❌ ④ pleasant: 원문은 annoying(짜증나는) ← 부적절

questions.passage: Think about eating chocolate chips. The first chip is ①<u>delicious</u>: sweet, melt­in­your­mouth goodness. The second chip is also pretty good. But by the fourth, fifth, or tenth chip in a row, the goodness is no longer as ②<u>pleasurable</u>. We adapt. Interspersing positive experiences with less positive ones, however, can ③<u>accelerate</u> adaptation. Eating a Brussels sprout between chocolate chips or viewing commercials between parts of TV shows ④<u>disrupts</u> the process.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ accelerate(가속하다) → slow down(늦추다): 덜 긍정적 경험을 끼워 넣으면 적응이 느려지므로 accelerate는 부적절
det.analysis:
① delicious: 첫 번째 칩은 맛있다 ← 적절
② pleasurable: 더 이상 즐겁지 않다 ← 적절
❌ ③ accelerate: 원문 논지상 적응을 ‘늦추는’ 것이므로 accelerate(가속)는 부적절 → slow down
④ disrupts: 과정을 방해한다 ← 적절
